purpose_context: The felix-admin-capture agent finalizes each routed inbox file with a sequence of separate LLM-issued tool calls (frontmatter write, file move, log append) that has no atomicity, no error surface, and no idempotent recovery — which has twice left files silently stuck in an inconsistent state. This mission delivers a helper the agent invokes once per file so the deterministic cleanup runs reliably and failures are visible.
purpose_tldr: Make inbox post-routing cleanup a single atomic, idempotent, error-surfacing helper instead of fragile inline agent tool calls.
